subject: RM_Thornhold
departures: Quills massed on the head, face and forequarters, pointing forward at the viewer, not swept back over the rump
A whip-like quilled lash (a tail or limb set with quills) held ready to strike
Quill tips visibly venomed: wet, stained or discoloured at the points
A low, narrow, elongated body built to thread tight tunnels, not a rounded, waddling porcupine bulk
